title: "RNA-seq Cohort Explorer"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    social: menu
    source_code: embed
runtime: shiny
---

```{r global, include=FALSE}
library(shiny); library(flexdashboard); library(plotly); library(DT)
library(ggplot2); library(survival); library(survminer)

# Resolve paths relative to the repository root regardless of where the app is launched
root <- normalizePath(if (dir.exists("R")) "." else "..")
for (f in list.files(file.path(root, "R"), full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.R$")) source(f)

cfg <- read_cohort_config(file.path(root, "config", "cohorts.csv"))
cohort_ids <- stats::setNames(cfg$cohort, cfg$label)
cohorts <- lapply(cfg$cohort, load_cohort, data_dir = file.path(root, "data"))
names(cohorts) <- cfg$cohort
genesets <- load_genesets(file.path(root, "data", "genesets.rds"))

cache_dir <- file.path(root, "cache"); dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
n_label <- function(id) {
  c <- cohorts[[id]]
  sprintf("%s: %d patients with RNA-seq, %d with survival data", id, ncol(c$matrix), nrow(c$survival))
}
```

Gene Expression
=======================================================================

Inputs {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Gene association

Enter two HGNC gene symbols (e.g. EGFR, ERBB2). Spearman correlation is computed across patients.

```{r}
textInput("gene1", "Gene 1 symbol:", value = "EGFR")
textInput("gene2", "Gene 2 symbol:", value = "ERBB2")
selectInput("cohort1", "Patient cohort:", cohort_ids)
checkboxInput("transformed", "Natural log transform", value = TRUE)
renderText(n_label(input$cohort1))
```

Outputs
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Correlation plot

```{r}
cor_res <- reactive({
  req(input$gene1, input$gene2)
  g <- toupper(trimws(c(input$gene1, input$gene2)))
  validate(need(all(g %in% rownames(cohorts[[input$cohort1]]$matrix)),
                "Gene symbol not found in this cohort"))
  correlate_genes(cohorts[[input$cohort1]]$matrix, g[1], g[2], input$transformed)
})

renderPlotly({
  r <- cor_res(); d <- r$data
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(.data[[names(d)[1]]], .data[[names(d)[2]]])) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) + theme_classic() +
    labs(x = paste(names(d)[1], "mRNA expression"), y = paste(names(d)[2], "mRNA expression"))
  ggplotly(p) %>% layout(title = list(text = paste0(
    "Correlation plot for ", input$cohort1, "<br><sup>Spearman rho ", round(r$rho, 2),
    "; ", format_p(r$p), "</sup>")))
})
```

### Expression distribution

```{r}
renderPlot({
  d <- cor_res()$data
  ord <- order(d[[1]], decreasing = TRUE)
  op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(1, 4, 3, 1)); on.exit(par(op))
  barplot(d[[1]][ord], main = names(d)[1], ylab = "expression")
  barplot(d[[2]][ord], main = names(d)[2], ylab = "expression")
})
```

Pathway Analysis
=======================================================================

Inputs {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Pathway analysis

Genes are ranked by Spearman correlation with the query gene and tested against a gene-set
collection with pre-ranked GSEA. First run for a new query takes 10-30 s; results are cached.

```{r}
textInput("gene", "Gene symbol:", value = "EGFR")
selectInput("set", "Gene set collection:", names(genesets))
selectInput("cohort", "Patient cohort:", cohort_ids)
numericInput("pval", "Significance threshold (FDR)", value = 0.05, min = 0, max = 1, step = 0.01)
```

Outputs
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Pathways table

```{r}
pathways <- reactive({
  req(input$gene)
  g <- toupper(trimws(input$gene))
  cohort <- cohorts[[input$cohort]]
  validate(need(g %in% rownames(cohort$matrix), "Gene symbol not found in this cohort"))
  f <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(g, "_", input$cohort, "_", input$set, "_", input$pval, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(f)) return(readRDS(f))
  withProgress(message = "Running GSEA", value = 0.5, {
    ranked <- rank_by_correlation(cohort$matrix, g, cohort$top_genes)
    res <- run_gsea(ranked, genesets[[input$set]], input$pval)
  })
  saveRDS(res, f)
  res
})

DT::renderDataTable({
  title <- paste(toupper(trimws(input$gene)), input$cohort)
  btn <- lapply(c("copy", "csv", "excel", "pdf", "print"), function(b) list(extend = b, title = title))
  DT::datatable(pathways(), rownames = FALSE, extensions = "Buttons", fillContainer = TRUE,
                options = list(dom = "Blfrtip", buttons = btn,
                               lengthMenu = list(c(25, 50, -1), c("25", "50", "All"))))
})
```

Overall Survival
=======================================================================

Inputs {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Untick the max-stat option to split patients at the **median** instead of the optimal cut-point.

```{r}
textInput("gene_os", "Gene symbol:", value = "EGFR")
selectInput("cohort_os", "Patient cohort:", cohort_ids)
checkboxInput("maxstat", "Max-stat method for optimal cutoff", value = TRUE)
renderText(n_label(input$cohort_os))
```

Outputs
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Kaplan-Meier curve

```{r}
surv_res <- reactive({
  req(input$gene_os)
  g <- toupper(trimws(input$gene_os))
  c <- cohorts[[input$cohort_os]]
  validate(need(g %in% rownames(c$matrix), "Gene symbol not found in this cohort"))
  stratify_survival(c$matrix, c$survival, g, input$maxstat)
})

renderPlot({
  d <- surv_res()$data
  fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, death) ~ group, data = d)
  ggsurvplot(fit, data = d, xlab = "Months", ylab = "Overall survival probability",
             pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE)
})
```

### Cutoff analysis

```{r}
renderPlot({
  r <- surv_res()
  if (!is.null(r$cutpoint)) {
    plot(r$cutpoint, "expression")
  } else {
    v <- sort(r$data$expression, decreasing = TRUE)
    barplot(v, ylab = "expression", sub = "Median shown as dashed red line")
    abline(h = median(v), col = "red", lty = 2)
  }
})
```

About
=======================================================================

#### Data
Public TCGA PanCancer Atlas RNA-seq (RSEM, batch-normalised) and overall survival, downloaded
from [cBioPortal](https://www.cbioportal.org). Primary tumours only, one sample per patient.

#### Pathway analysis
Pre-ranked GSEA (`clusterProfiler`): the top 15,000 genes by median expression are ranked by Spearman
correlation with the query gene and tested against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome or KEGG (legacy) sets.

#### Caveats
- Gene-level expression only; no isoform quantification.
- Exploratory tool: multiple testing applies, so use hypothesis-driven queries.
